With extraordinary size and energy fluctuations, it is guaranteed to hatch into a Shelly with the <style=Hint_BgL>Alpha mutation</style>.
They say an Aniimo’s passing is different from a person’s death. Aniimo are born from Idyll, and to Idyll they return.
Perhaps to the stars, the woods, or the sea...
After they return, this land gives rise to new Eggs.
Then, as new lives, they meet us again.

name: Ancestor Prism
description:
A ceremonial object discovered in an underground temple, protected by a powerful Aniimo.
Mysterious divine patterns cover its surface, with faint images and text visible within its core, their meaning still undeciphered.
Principal Oswen notes that it has appeared several times throughout Idyll mythology, each appearance signaling imminent transformation.
Like a mysterious cosmic die that determines the land’s destiny and initiates new chapters in history.
The nature of changes it brings this time awaits discovery by Pathfinders.
funcRep: Ancient Idyll artifact with undetermined origins.

name: Ancient Recipe
description:
A very ancient recipe, written in the ancient Idyllian language, now mostly faded. Luckily BINI can translate it:
Offer the fragrance of life and growth, and the Aeons shall grant the blessing of regeneration.
Offer the fragrance of tolerance and change, and the Aeons shall grant the blessing of protection.
Offer the fragrance of courage and passion, and the Aeons shall grant the blessing of hope.

name: Archival Chip - Helgon Cave Mural
description: A Helgon, a Rookey, and an Infergon are chatting in a circle, while Helmuts and Jawlings are sleeping on the ground. One of the Jawlings even has its teeth on a Helmut’s helmet... Someone recorded all this in an ancient language. Maybe a long time ago, Helmuts and Jawlings were friends.

name: Archival Chip - Mural of Infergon’s Birth
description:
Long ago, the mountains of the Russet Highlands surged and boiled, and the earth trembled violently. The Aniimo clans that lived here faced catastrophe.
Then a Helmwhelp rushed to the summit and, enduring the searing agony that engulfed its body, swallowed a Flame Flower that bloomed brightly amid the raging inferno.
The mountains returned to peace, but the Helmwhelp’s body was scorched blood-red. From then on, it could breathe roaring flames, transforming into the legendary Infergon.
funcRep: Archival Content: An ancient mural on the island of Helgons.

name: Maze of Thorns Tale 1
description: To the Thornblade guards, Princess Melloblum is the fairest blossom of their lineage, a treasure demanding meticulous protection. While all revere her, the First Lethal Thorn recognizes that this attention suffocates her. Yet these Thornblades, who wear their duty as honor, never pause to consider Melloblum’s own desires.
funcRep: Entry: Your Observations in the Maze of Thorns.

name: Maze of Thorns Tale 2
description: Two little Budsquires, raised in the Maze of Thorns, knew the dangers of the outside world. Yet still, they longed to see it. Even if the thorns cut them, even if the pain made them weep, they kept reaching higher, desperate for a glimpse of the world beyond.
funcRep: Entry: Your Observations in the Maze of Thorns.

name: Maze of Thorns Tale 3
description: "Banished" from the princess’s tea party, the observant Budsquires noticed Princess Melloblum’s subdued spirits. The First Lethal Thorn’s intervention, meant as protection, had only deepened her quiet distress. Where the Budsquires could release their pain in tears, the princess swallowed her tears, aware that her moods affected the entire court. The radiant figure who brought smiles to others wore none of her own.
funcRep: Entry: Your Observations in the Maze of Thorns.

name: Maze of Thorns Tale 4
description: The previous Princess Melloblum had exhausted herself for her people’s happiness—a sacrifice that haunted the former First Lethal Thorn with guilt. So it trained its apprentice to become the perfect guardian: one who could detect and eliminate any danger to the princess without hesitation. But years later, it realized its mistake. "Thorns hardened by tears grow unyielding, yet lose their scent." A First Lethal Thorn that knew nothing of joy could only bring sorrow to those it sought to protect.
funcRep: Entry: Your Observations in the Maze of Thorns.

name: Echoes of a Vigil.
description:
Through endless cycles of the moon,
beyond the death of distant stars...
Still the Echoback’s spirit stays untouched by solitude.
For beyond canvas’s edge, age-old songs still resound.
That gleaming hope within the notes, an echo of endless vigil.
funcRep:
A painting gifted by Sorora.
Beneath the starry sky, an Echoback’s eternal spirit maintains its vigil over endless waves.
Who would have known, how many tides have ebbed and flowed under her watch?

name: Symphony of Reunion.
description:
The gulf between life and death stretches beyond the vast distance starlight travels to reach us.
Yet within this Echoback Song rings a symphony of joyous reunion.
Their convergence in paint was fated, for no tide could ever wash away their eternal bond.
All rivers return to the sea as the memories flows through each current.

An Echoback’s spirit flies to reunite with her loved ones,
beneath an ocean of stars.

funcRep: Amber infused with Lumin Power. Branches in the Whisperwake Isles can absorb its energy to grow.

name: Moonray Wheat
description: Moonlit wheat, each ear a treasure.
funcRep: This precious wheat only grows during the full-moon season. Yama, GoGoHomes’ chief designer, is collecting it, and she’ll trade rare seasonal furniture for every special ear you bring her!

name: Primegy
description: The Omni-glove is equipped with an energy monitoring system that rations its energy use during certain activities, helping prevent over-exploration from harming Idyll’s ecosystem.
funcRep: Consumed in certain activities. Recovers 1 every 6 minutes, up to 300. Can also be replenished with Primegy Batteries.

name: Stamp
description: The Stamp Rush event is jointly hosted by Polaris Institute and Astra’s enterprises to honor Pathfinders who have made outstanding contributions in exploring Idyll.
funcRep: Earned by playing various modes. Spend in the Stamp Shop to exchange for valuable rewards.

name: Trade Currency

funcRep: The standard currency issued by Astra.

name: Voxel Coin

funcRep: In Astra, you can spend Voxel Coins at the Shop to buy items, or play Super Lucky Star and try your luck!

name: Windchaser Stamp

name: Windrise Stamp
